policy: ADR 0002 runtime escalation; Phase 4 batch on the macOS reference host. Not executed. Each probe states the static expectation it can confirm or refute.
capture: For timing probes: record the master output (or a click-only audio clip) and the Live transport position via a MIDI-clock or Link-free audio capture; derive the launch beat from the first transient relative to the bar-1 downbeat. Retain the .als, the capture and the measured beat.

probes.question: Is the launch boundary the next grid line at or after the press, or strictly after it, and how close to a boundary may a press be before the following boundary is used?
probes.static_expectation: B = anchor + ceil((t - anchor)/g)*g; if B - now is below an offset returned by an unresolved virtual call (0x101ad1418), B + g is used while playing (0x101ad0130).
probes.input: Base set, 4/4, 120 BPM, GlobalQuantisation 4 (1 Bar), one 1-bar session clip with LaunchQuantisation 0; launch from a scripted MIDI note at song beats 1.5, 3.9, 3.99 and exactly 4.0 (MIDI clock-locked sender).
probes.observation: Song beat at which the clip's first sample sounds for each press.
probes.stop: Four presses measured with two repeats each; stop if the capture jitter exceeds 1/64 beat.

probes.question: Is the bar grid anchored at the start of the current time-signature segment?
probes.static_expectation: Anchor = max(0, segment start); with 4/4 to 3/4 at beat 8 and 1 Bar quantization, a press at beat 9 starts at beat 11.
probes.input: Base set with a time-signature change to 3/4 at beat 8 (arrangement), GlobalQuantisation 4; press at beat 9.
probes.observation: Launch beat (11 versus 12 or another value).

probes.question: Does an explicit clip quantization in bars use the clip's own time signature for the grid length?
probes.static_expectation: Clip LaunchQuantisation k >= 1 uses grid(clip signature, k-1); a 6/8 clip with k = 5 (1 Bar) in a 4/4 song uses 3 beats.
probes.input: Base set 4/4; one clip set to 6/8 with LaunchQuantisation 5; press at beat 1.2 and 4.2.
probes.observation: Launch beats (3 and 6 expected) versus 4 and 8.

probes.question: Do None (clip value 1) and Global with GlobalQuantisation 0 launch immediately, and what does 'immediately' mean in beats?
probes.static_expectation: Grid 0.0 for both, so no ceil step; launch at the current position plus the unresolved offset.
probes.input: Base set, Vocal Recording.als (GlobalQuantisation 0, SHA-256 d12d2102...c26e), and a clip with LaunchQuantisation 1.
probes.observation: Latency between press and clip start, in beats, at 120 BPM.

probes.question: Where does a clip start when it is launched with the transport stopped?
probes.static_expectation: Unknown: the playing test 0x101acfe68 is false, so the +g step is skipped; the transport start path is outside this packet.
probes.input: Base set stopped at beat 0 and at beat 5.3; launch one session clip.
probes.observation: Song position at which playback begins and clip offset.

probes.question: Observable behaviour of LaunchMode 1 (Gate), 2 (Toggle) and 3 (Repeat) on press and release.
probes.static_expectation: Labels and values only (Trigger 0, Gate 1, Toggle 2, Repeat 3); the per-track fire state machine 0x101ad0130 was not interpreted.
probes.input: Base set; four copies of one clip, one per mode, launched from a mapped MIDI note held for 2.5 beats at 1/4 global quantization.
probes.observation: Start, stop and retrigger beats per mode; whether release is quantized.

probes.question: What does Legato change at launch?
probes.static_expectation: Legato is sent to the engine with the slot fire data; the API text says force_legato plays immediately and moves the playhead to stay synchronized.
probes.input: Two 4-bar clips on one track; clip B Legato on; launch B at beat 6 while A plays from beat 0.
probes.observation: Position inside B at which playback begins (beat 2 of B expected if legato preserves position) and when.

probes.question: How does VelocityAmount (stored 0..1) scale clip volume by launch velocity?
probes.static_expectation: Range 0..1, default 0; the gain law is not traced.
probes.input: Audio clip of a constant tone; VelocityAmount 0, 0.5 and 1; launches with MIDI velocity 127, 64 and 1.

probes.question: Fate of out-of-range enum values in a document.
probes.static_expectation: The generic loader stores the integer without a range check; grid() returns 0.0 (no quantization) for clip values >= 15 or < 1 other than 0, and for global values outside 1..13; the API setters would reject them.
probes.input: Chord C Minor9 Staggered.alc edited to LaunchQuantisation 15, then -1; LaunchMode 4; a set with GlobalQuantisation 14.
probes.observation: Opens or error; displayed chooser value; launch timing; value written on re-save.

probes.question: Follow-action chance normalization and missing launch fields on load.
probes.static_expectation: Post-load 0x1025044b4 sets ChanceA = round(A/((A+B)/100)), ChanceB = 100 - ChanceA; A = B = 0 gives 100/0 and FollowActionEnabled false. A missing LaunchMode or LaunchQuantisation keeps the constructor value, which comes from the user's ClipDefaultLaunchMode / ClipDefaultQuantisation preference.
probes.input: Clip edited to FollowChanceA 30 / FollowChanceB 30; another to 0 / 0 with FollowActionEnabled true; a third without LaunchMode and LaunchQuantisation elements, opened with the preferences set to Gate and 1/4.
probes.stop: One open and re-save per edit.

probes.question: When does a follow action fire for IsLinked true versus false?
probes.static_expectation: The engine receives LoopIterations only when IsLinked is true (INT_MIN otherwise) and FollowTime always; shipped linked clips keep FollowTime 4 regardless of loop length.
probes.input: A 2-bar clip with FollowActionEnabled true, A = Next; IsLinked true with LoopIterations 2; then IsLinked false with FollowTime 6.
probes.observation: Beat at which the next clip launches.
